visualRisks.description: The route includes several turns and obstacles that may obstruct the view, such as the house at position (53) and dock at position (104).
There is a potential contrast issue between the road color (#667b8a) and ground color (#283e35), which might make it difficult to distinguish them in certain areas.

navigationRisks.description: The route involves a complex path with many turns, making navigation challenging. The route includes sharp turns and obstacles that could lead to confusion or difficulty for players.
There are several positions in the district where the route seems to end abruptly (e.g., positions 103, 116), which might confuse players who expect a continuous path.
